changelog: v1.8.0 — LinkedIn jobs that apply on the company's site can be added too (Add Job): the company's exact apply link is read from LinkedIn's job data — or, if LinkedIn doesn't give it, caught from the tab its Apply button opens (that tab is closed right away); it is added as an outside job, bid from Out Bids. Easy Apply jobs get two buttons: Add + Gen CV, or Add Job (CV later).
